Description: Detailed classification for policies/activities. Function-based grouping: each label denotes the type of policy instrument / activity (what it does), not its legal force. Statutory vs non-statutory status is recorded separately in Statutory_Basis. Action plans with a delivery schedule are classed as Plan; direction-setting documents as Strategy / Framework. Funds are grouped under Economic / market instrument; one-off commissioned reviews (distinct from recurring statutory assessments) under Independent Review / Inquiry.
Controlled_Vocabulary: Strategy / Framework | Plan | Scheme / Programme | Economic / market instrument | Standard / Code | Assessment / Evidence | Independent Review / Inquiry | Guidance / Methodology | Coordination body / Working group

Description: Hard amendment/consolidation links between Acts/SIs. Bracketed codes.
Soft links to related but non-enabling legislation/policies/orgs. Bracketed codes.
Hard link: this record is a component of the named parent programme.
Hard link: funding programme financing this record (review-volatile).
Reciprocal back-link to international governance workbook records that reference this UK record via their UK_Links. Bracketed codes.

All cross-reference codes must be wrapped in square brackets — [LEG-NNN], [ORG-NNN], [POL-NNN], [INT-L/INT-O/INT-P-NNN], [EU-L-NNN] and [IFW-NN] — wherever they appear in a cell, regardless of any surrounding text. Codes are the join keys used by check_links.py; unbracketed codes are invisible to integrity checking.
Controlled_Vocabulary: Square brackets mandatory. Sole exception: the Record_ID / Framework_ID primary-key columns, which are never bracketed.

Description: Peer / national-analogue public bodies across the four UK administrations (soft, undirected). Narrative reciprocal mentions retained in Remit_And_Powers.
